GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Generates a concise, customer-friendly summary of a Truist Knowledge Article for use in chat responses or Agentforce actions. Supports dynamic Knowledge summaries for credit card articles.

inputs.definition: The title of the Knowledge Article being summarized (e.g., "Truist Enjoy Beyond Credit Card").
The full or partial body text of the Knowledge Article. Up to 3000 characters recommended for best results.

templateVersions.title: Truist Knowledge Article Summarizer v1.0
